design_concept: Neo-Arcade Fusion: Blending deep 8-bit nostalgia with smooth, contemporary bento layouts and bouncy cartoon interactions. A premium, mobile-first gaming platform built to dominate the app store.

headings.rationale: A contemporary wide display font that feels gamer-centric, bold, and playful without resorting to overused retro cliches.

body.rationale: Ultra-clean geometric sans that ensures high readability for rules, descriptions, and UI text.

accents.rationale: Used sparingly for purely nostalgic elements: High scores, retro 'GAME OVER' tags, and leader board ranks.

scale_rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-black
scale_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight uppercase font-bold

background.description: Deepest Midnight Indigo. Never use pure black. Tinted blue/purple to feel like a glowing arcade cabinet in the dark.

primary.description: Bubblegum Pink. Bouncy, vibrant, and energetic. Used for primary CTAs and active states.

accents.description: Electric Cyan, Arcade Yellow, Gameboy Green. Use as glowing accents for game cards, player stats, and success states.

text.description: High contrast white for primary text, cool lavender-grey for secondary text.

rules.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Glow effects (drop-shadow) must not replace actual contrast.
rules.gradients: NO flat gradients. Use CSS radial-gradients with opacity for background 'glow' behind bento cards, simulating CRT screen light bleed.

surfaces.glassmorphism: Used for floating bottom nav and sticky headers. bg-[#16152B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]
surfaces.cards: Solid surface (#16152B) with a sharp 2px border inside, slightly rounded (rounded-2xl) but feeling chunky and tactile.

textures.grain: Apply a subtle SVG noise overlay (opacity-5) globally to eliminate digital flatness and evoke CRT screen feel.
textures.scanlines: Optional repeating-linear-gradient overlay on the hero banner for intense retro effect.

mobile_first.navigation: Thumb-reachable Bottom Navigation Bar for mobile (Home, Library, Leaderboard, Profile). Hide on desktop in favor of a top sticky nav.
mobile_first.spacing: Generous touch targets (min 48px). Use p-4 on mobile, p-8 on tablet/desktop.

grids.home_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-4 md:gap-6. Hero section spanning col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2. Game cards spanning col-span-4.
grids.leaderboard: Dense list layout. flex-col gap-2 with strict optical alignment. Avatar left, Rank right-aligned, Score in Silkscreen font.

GameCard.structure: Relative wrapper, responsive image background max-h-[250px], dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0B0A1A] to-transparent), absolute bottom-left text.
GameCard.interaction: Hover/Tap: hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)] transition-all duration-300. Adds a cartoon 'bounce' via framer-motion.

PlayButton.style: Chunky pill-shaped button. bg-[#FF479A] text-white font-['Unbounded'] uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 rounded-full border-b-4 border-[#C11264] active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-1 transition-all.

LeaderboardRow.style: Glassy row bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-4 flex items-center justify-between. Top 3 ranks get special glowing borders (Gold/Yellow for #1).

animations.page_transition: Fade in and slide up slightly (y: 20 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1) with spring physics for bounce.
animations.micro_interactions: Tap scale down (scale: 0.95). Hover scale up (scale: 1.05).

effects.click: Tactile arcade button 'clack' or coin insert 'ding'
effects.toggle: Provide a global sound toggle switch (Mute/Unmute) prominently in the header/profile.

hero_background.description: Glowing Pac-man arcade game screen, perfect for the hero section background with a heavy dark overlay.

snakes_and_ladders_thumbnail.description: Checkered Snake and Ladders board for the game selection card.

playing_cards_thumbnail.description: Vintage attire poker/cards playing scene for Crazy Eights game card.

arcade_cabinet_general.description: Close-up of vintage arcade machine lit by neon lights, for general app background or empty states.

accessibility.contrast: Use APCA calculator. Ensure dark pinks/blues have white text on top.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-label to all game cards and icon-only buttons (like the sound toggle).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via framer-motion useReducedMotion hook.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install custom fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600&family=Silkscreen&family=Unbounded:wght@700;900&display=swap');
Ensure 'RMC' vibe is present: the UI should feel incredibly nostalgic but operate smoothly. Do not make the UI look broken or purely 8-bit.
Implement the bottom navigation bar for mobile screens (< md breakpoint) using fixed bottom-0 positioning with safe-area padding.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or standard date pickers; use Shadcn equivalents heavily customized with Tailwind.
For the game screens themselves (the game board area), reserve a large flex-1 container that scales responsively without scrolling on mobile.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use 'sonner' for toasts located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js (Note: use .js extension as per the repository setup).
